paragraphs.source_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu dismissed his attendants and sat alone before his meal tray, when an inexplicable loneliness suddenly came over him. It startled him. The five dishes and two soups on the tray were as familiar as ever, while the servants and Lady Okame sat quietly nearby as usual. Why, then, did he feel so desolate? Though he asked himself again and again, no certain answer came.

paragraphs.source_en: To the eyes of the world, Ieyasu's entry into Osaka Castle on this occasion must have seemed an extraordinary stroke of fortune, but matters were far from so simple.
